verdict.rationale: Snyk ships an official open-source CLI (github.com/snyk/cli, documented at docs.snyk.io). It covers `snyk test`, `snyk code test`, `snyk secrets test`, `snyk monitor`, IaC and container scanning, and runs locally, in IDEs and in CI/CD with dedicated service-account roles. It has AI-native hooks: `snyk fix --agentic` provides human-in-the-loop remediation, and the local MCP server runs on top of the Snyk CLI. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the CLI experience, and explicit evidence of machine-readable output modes for agent consumption.
